old_watermark:
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rake_records rr LEFT JOIN public.daemon_state ds ON ds.daemon='rakeback_settler'
          WHERE NOT COALESCE(rr.is_tournament,false) AND rr.tournament_id IS NULL AND rr.rake_amount>0
            AND rr.created_at>=v_from AND rr.created_at<v_end
            AND (rr.club_id=v_union.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.fn_accounting_week_clubs(v_union.id,NULL,v_from,v_end) uc WHERE uc.club_id=rr.club_id))
            AND (ds.high_water_mark IS NULL OR rr.created_at>ds.high_water_mark OR
              (rr.created_at=ds.high_water_mark AND (ds.high_water_mark_id IS NULL OR rr.id>ds.high_water_mark_id)))) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_rake_source_not_fully_accrued';
        END IF;
new_watermark:
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rake_records rr LEFT JOIN public.daemon_state ds ON ds.daemon='rakeback_settler'
          WHERE rr.is_tournament IS NOT TRUE AND rr.tournament_id IS NULL AND rr.rake_amount>0
            AND rr.created_at>=COALESCE((SELECT watermark.high_water_mark FROM public.daemon_state watermark WHERE watermark.daemon='rakeback_settler'),v_from)
            AND rr.created_at>=v_from AND rr.created_at<v_end
            AND (rr.club_id=v_union.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.fn_accounting_week_clubs(v_union.id,NULL,v_from,v_end) uc WHERE uc.club_id=rr.club_id))
            AND (ds.high_water_mark IS NULL OR rr.created_at>ds.high_water_mark OR
              (rr.created_at=ds.high_water_mark AND (ds.high_water_mark_id IS NULL OR rr.id>ds.high_water_mark_id)))) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_rake_source_not_fully_accrued';
        END IF;
old_cash:
SELECT s.club_id,max(s.earned_at) AS latest FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s
 WHERE s.coordinator_union_id=p_union_id AND s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to GROUP BY s.club_id
new_cash: SELECT w.club_id,latest.earned_at AS latest FROM (WITH RECURSIVE cash_walk(club_id) AS ((SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s WHERE s.club_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT n.club_id FROM cash_walk w CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s WHERE s.club_id>w.club_id ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1) n) SELECT cash_walk.club_id FROM cash_walk) w CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.earned_at FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s WHERE s.club_id=w.club_id AND s.coordinator_union_id=p_union_id AND s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to ORDER BY s.earned_at DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) latest
